verdict.rationale: Shopify POS has its own documented public developer API: POS UI extensions on shopify.dev, with APIs such as shopify.storage, shopify.toast and shopify.action.presentModal(), CLI scaffolding, and extensions that can call the GraphQL Admin API via fetch(). However, this API extends the POS interface from inside the app. The evidence does not show an external programmatic interface for driving POS operations such as carts and checkouts directly. missing for 10: documented external API for programmatically driving POS sales/carts, API reference depth (endpoints, auth, scopes), independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: With Shopify POS UI extensions, you can add custom functionality directly into Shopify's point-of-sale interface.
Extensions can also query the GraphQL Admin API directly using standard fetch() calls.
shopify.storage persists data between sessions, shopify.toast displays feedback messages, and shopify.action.presentModal() launches full-screen workflows.
